Context summary:

## Goal

Repair Focus Desk D2 session history so a session records the task’s current title when it ends, while retaining a stored title if the task was deleted.

## State

- Done: Built focus sessions, persistence, visibility-aware timing, and module-serving regression coverage. Fixed missing `/src/focus.js` route.
- In Progress: Implement the title-at-end snapshot repair and update D2 evidence.
- Blocked: None.

## Highlights

- Existing completed history must remain unchanged.
- End-state coverage required for early finish, cancellation, and automatic completion.
- Test rename before ending and another rename afterward.
- If the linked task no longer exists, preserve the prior stored title.
- Do not edit conversation archive or annotation scripts.

## Next

1. Inspect focus session/domain logic and existing tests.
2. Update finalization logic to resolve the current task title only at session end, with deleted-task fallback.
3. Add targeted tests for all requested end paths and rename timing.
4. Run relevant tests and `npm run check`.
5. Update `evidence/d2-focus-sessions-review.md` with results and leave status In Progress pending review approval.

## Files

Read: none in this continuation  
Edited: none in this continuation

content.text:
Implemented the D2 title-snapshot repair.

- Ended sessions now use the task’s current title for early finish, cancellation, and automatic completion.
- If the task was deleted, ending falls back to the title saved on the active session.
- Finished records remain unchanged after later task renames.
- Added focused coverage and updated the D2 review evidence.

Updated: [focus.js](/Users/andychen/Documents/ChatGPT/Vibe%20Code/focus-desk/src/focus.js), [app.js](/Users/andychen/Documents/ChatGPT/Vibe%20Code/focus-desk/src/app.js), [focus.test.js](/Users/andychen/Documents/ChatGPT/Vibe%20Code/focus-desk/tests/focus.test.js), and [D2 evidence](/Users/andychen/Documents/ChatGPT/Vibe%20Code/focus-desk/evidence/d2-focus-sessions-review.md).

Validation passed:

- `node --test tests/focus.test.js` — 6 passed
- `npm test` — 30 passed, 1 skipped (restricted loopback listener)
- `npm run check` — passed
- `git diff --check` — passed

Status remains In Progress pending review approval.
